description: This file contains utility classes and methods for generated code in the Orleans serialization framework, including service resolution, service unwrapping, reflection helpers, and exception copying.

classes.name: RecursiveServiceResolutionState
classes.description: Tracks the depth and caller stack for service resolution to prevent cyclic dependencies.

classes.name: ExceptionCopier<T, B>
classes.description: Abstract base class for copying exception objects, utilizing activators and base type copiers.

methods.name: GetService
methods.description: Resolves and unwraps a service instance, considering caller context and service wrapping.

methods.name: UnwrapService
methods.description: Unwraps a wrapped service instance, considering caller context.

methods.name: TryGetService
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a caller object of a specific service type from the caller stack.

methods.name: GetOptionalCopier
methods.description: Returns the provided copier if it is not shallow-copyable; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: InvokableThrowArgumentOutOfRange
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException with a formatted message.

methods.name: ConsumeEndBaseOrEndObject
methods.description: Consumes an end-of-object marker in the serialization stream, expecting specific wire types.

methods.name: SerializeUnexpectedType
methods.description: Serializes a value of an unexpected type using the appropriate codec.

methods.name: DeserializeUnexpectedType
methods.description: Deserializes a value of an unexpected type using the appropriate codec.

methods.name: GetMethodInfoOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a MethodInfo matching specified name, generic parameters, and argument types, searching interfaces if necessary.
